'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Roy Bordier DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Roy Bordier]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Ray Bordier
* '''Username:''' Spectre
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
